lanes.name: NAND / FMC controller driver
lanes.ev: *** THIS IS NOW THE ROOT CAUSE OF THE BOOT PANIC, not a side lane. *** The read path returns 40 1f 00 00 (C70, the one proven-scratch cell, across SEVEN fires) while the vendor's DMA buffer fills with changing real flash data. CONFIG_CMDLINE roots from ubi.mtd=rootfsb -> /dev/ubiblock0_0, so a broken FMC read means no rootfs and no boot. Fixes tried and falsified: FMC_DATA_NUM/INT_EN, write-enable, partition-relative rows, SADDR_OOB, config registers, sfc_clk+resets. Vendor-side cell characterisation is the WRONG RUNTIME (3 clobberings); instruments must be self-proving.
